summary: Comprehensive backend + frontend testing of Runiq Insight. All backend endpoints (demo, upload CSV, upload XLSX, overview, insights, ask) return 200. Frontend flows verified: welcome -> demo -> overview KPIs, revenue trend, top products, top categories render correctly with real data. Business Insights shows 7 AI-enriched cards with WHAT/WHY/ACTION. Ask Runiq returns relevant AI answers. Sidebar navigation works. Page refresh returns user to welcome (per-session, no crash). The 'Session expired' bug (numpy.bool serialization on GET /api/overview) is RESOLVED.

issues: The 'WHY IT'S HAPPENING' and 'RECOMMENDED ACTION' text uses very light gray on light background — contrast appears low and hard to read. Meta labels like 'Home down -49%' also render in near-invisible gray. Consider darkening body text.
Recharts logs 'width(-1) height(-1)' warning briefly during initial render — cosmetic only, chart renders correctly after mount.

action_items: (Optional) Improve text contrast on Business Insights cards for WHY/ACTION body copy.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py _dataset_meta returns 404 with message 'Dataset not found or session expired'. Frontend maps this to 'Session expired' toast — fine, but could distinguish 404 vs other errors.
In-memory DATASETS dict grows unbounded — no TTL/eviction. Acceptable for MVP but note for prod.
analysis.compute_overview correctly casts numpy scalars via bool()/float()/int(); regression risk if similar unsafe casts are introduced elsewhere. Consider a shared _to_native helper.
seed_data_creation: Programmatic CSV and XLSX generated inside pytest for upload tests.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression suite lives at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py and covers demo/upload/overview/insights/ask + invalid file + unknown dataset 404. All UI data-testids are present and reliable.
rca of the issue: Bug was numpy.bool_ (from work['date'].notna().any()) being placed into the overview dict; FastAPI's default jsonable_encoder cannot serialize numpy.bool_ leading to 500 on GET /api/overview which the frontend interpreted as a 404 -> 'Session expired' toast. Fix in analysis.compute_overview casts has_date/has_category/has_product with bool(...). Verified: backend returns 200 and UI proceeds to Executive Overview without any 'Session expired' error.
